# PageHeader

The header region at the top of a page's content: module band, thin–bold title, one-line description, freshness stamp and the page's actions in one fixed order.

`SongNodes.PageHeader` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.PageHeader module="graph" moduleHref="…" title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.PageHeader" module="graph" module-href="…" title="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (PageHeaderProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `module` * | `"graph" \| "library" \| "sets" \| "paths" \| "harmony" \| "sources" \| "pipeline" \| "services"` | Module that owns the page; sets the band colour and the title lead. |
| `moduleHref` * | `string` | Href of the module index, linked from the band. |
| `section` | `string` | Optional sub-page shown in the band after "›" ("Saved sets"). |
| `title` * | `string` | Bold part of the title ("Peak time Friday"). |
| `description` | `string` | One-line description with the key numbers. |
| `stamp` | `{ verb: string; at: Date \| string }` | Freshness stamp: verb and time ("Saved", 24 Oct 2026 21:30). |
| `status` | `{ status; label: string }` | At most one status pill for the page. |
| `secondaryActions` | `MenuAction[]` | 0–2 visible secondary buttons; they fold into More actions under 600px. |
| `menuActions` | `MenuAction[]` | Further secondary actions, always in More actions. |
| `primaryAction` | `{ label: string; icon?: string; onClick: () => void; busyLabel?: string; busy?: boolean }` | The view's single primary action, placed last. |
| `onAction` | `(id: string) => void` | Called with any secondary or menu action id. |

### MenuAction

One action shown in an OverflowMenu or ContextMenu.

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` * | `string` | Stable id passed back to onSelect. |
| `label` * | `string` | Verb-first label in sentence case, e.g. "Export as CSV". |
| `icon` | `string` | Lucide icon name from assets/Icons. |
| `shortcut` | `string` | Shortcut hint shown as a key cap, e.g. "F". |
| `disabledReason` | `string` | When set the item is aria-disabled and this reason is shown under the label. |
| `destructive` | `boolean` | Destructive: status-bad text, placed last after a separator; label ends with "…". |
| `checked` | `boolean` | Makes it a menuitemcheckbox with this checked state. |
| `group` | `string` | Group heading this item sits under, e.g. "Route". |
